title: magnen77's Sniper Rifle
description: Adds Configurable sniper rifle in minecraft using only: datapack & resoursepack
body:
✨This datapack adds a Configurable Sniper Rifle with a bullet that increases its damage based on the distance traveled.

### 🔥How use:
   Sneak - scope.
   RMB(Use button) - shoot.

### 🎨How get without craft:
   /loot give @s loot sniper:ammo308 - for bullets.
   /loot give @s loot sniper:sniper_rifle - for sniper rifle.

### ⚙️Settings:
1) /scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar sniper.settings
     To view all settings.
2) /scoreboard players set $<setting_name> sniper.settings <value>
     To set the value of setting.
3) /scoreboard objectives remove sniper.settings & /reload
     To reset the settings.
  About the settings:
   1) $angle - the angle at which the bullet falls.
   2) $lifetime - the "lifetime" of bullet.
   3) $twisting - a time when the bullet is not subject to physics.
   4) $base_damage - minimum bullet damage.
   5) $damage_k - the value by which the bullet's damage increases each tick.
   6) $deflection - bullet deviation during an unaimed shot.
   7) $tracec_per_tick - the number of bullet teleports is 0.4 blocks per tick (roughly speaking, the speed of a bullet)
   8) $max_damage - hmmm... Maximum bullet damage, probably...
